name: Long Put (ATM swing)
summary: Buy the ~-0.50 delta put for a 1-3 week bearish swing with maximum gamma per dollar.

greeks.gamma: maximal for a single long put

when_to_use: High-conviction short-term bearish swing with IVR < 35.
entry_rules: Trigger: daily close below a 20-day low, or price loses the 50 EMA on above-average volume
management_rules: Time stop at 21 DTE or 10 trading days held
If delta reaches -0.75, take profit or roll down to a fresh -0.50 strike and bank the difference
exit_rules: Sell to close at +75%, -40%, 21 DTE, or 10 trading days
15:30 ET expiry-day flatten to avoid auto-exercise into short stock
assignment_risk: None (long); auto-exercise into short 100 shares is the hazard.
common_mistakes: Buying ATM puts during a VIX spike and paying peak vega for a move that is already half over.
